subject: expression: don't cast collation for in expression is the new collation is disabled (#52812)
summary: Reviewed first-parent diff: pkg/planner/core/expression_rewriter.go adds an early return in castCollationForIn when collate.NewCollationEnabled() is false, preventing the reported ColumnSubstituteImpl panic in old-collation (binary-compare) mode while leaving new-collation-enabled behavior unchanged. No Blocker/High correctness/semantics issues found in-scope; the same guard is still present on upstream/master.
